newsitem.title: USA: Advocat Inc president moves to Canada unit.
newsitem.headline: Advocat Inc president moves to Canada unit.

text.p: Advocat Inc said on Thursday that its president and chief operating officer, Paul Richardson, has moved over to the company's subsidiary Diversicare Canada Management Services, where he is president and chief executive.
Chairman and chief executive Charles Birkett will assume Richardson's duties as president and chief operating officer.
JoAnn Verbanic, senior vice president for U.S. operations, will report directly to Birkett.
Advocat operates 64 nursing homes and 22 assisted living facilities in nine Southeastern U.S. states and two Canadian provinces. Its shares were trading down 1/8 to nine at midday Thursday.
